title: From a rough idea to a sealed result.
subtitle: ONE REQUIREMENT. EVERY STEP ACCOUNTED FOR.

scenes.heading: Start with the messy version.
lines: Count how often each link is used.
Let a teammate set it up easily.
Question: how fast is fast enough?
scenes.body: The agent keeps the raw notes and asks for the missing constraints.
scenes.trace: The idea becomes a requirement that can be checked.
scenes.footer: Example: a small link shortener. The same flow fits your project.

scenes.heading: Give the goal a measurable bar.
lines: SC-002  Redirect p95 <= 50 ms at 200 req/s
SC-003  No links lost after a restart
SC-004  Local setup in under 10 minutes
Also: user stories, requirements, edge cases.
We will follow SC-002 through the whole flow.
scenes.body: The agent turns intent into user stories and measurable success criteria.
scenes.trace: SC-002: p95 <= 50 ms at 200 requests per second.
scenes.footer: Clarify the target before writing the execution plan.

scenes.heading: Define how the agent proves it.
lines: Owner-only: latency limit and request rate.
scenes.body: Stages name commands, dependencies, outputs, checks, retry limits and owner gates.
scenes.footer: Illustrative excerpt. Full syntax lives in the bundled worked example.

scenes.heading: Turn the plan into tracked work.
lines: + stage tasks with inputs and a done bar
+ profile stages for the run order
scenes.body: Intake maps the spec and runbook into checklist rows, task contracts and profile stages.
scenes.trace: SC-002 now has a row, covering checks and a stage task.
scenes.footer: When the spec changes, intake updates the affected rows.

scenes.heading: The agent works. The checks decide.
scenes.body: At the authorized level, the agent claims work, implements, runs checks and captures evidence.
scenes.trace: SC-002 -> attempt 1 -> FAIL. A failed check is not completion.
scenes.footer: Illustrative results. These numbers are a walkthrough, not a benchmark.

scenes.heading: Retry the work. Keep the same bar.
lines: RUN     attempt 2 within the declared limits
scenes.body: A permitted retry can change a declared knob. The owner controls the acceptance threshold.
scenes.trace: SC-002 stays unchanged while the permitted retry changes WORKERS.
scenes.footer: Missing inputs, exhausted retries and owner decisions are surfaced.

scenes.heading: A passing check earns evidence.
lines: NEXT    write the report for the completed work
A sealed report lets the task close.
scenes.body: Keep the result and failed attempt. The next session can read what happened and what is owed.
scenes.trace: SC-002 -> attempt 2 -> PASS -> evidence ready for the report.
scenes.footer: Illustrative results. The agent still needs to document and seal the work.

scenes.heading: Finish with something you can inspect.
lines: What       Met the redirect latency criterion.
Result     41.2 ms p95 at 200 req/s. PASS.
Issues     First attempt: 68.4 ms. Kept on record.
Reproduce  Run the recorded command and settings.
SEAL       Report and evidence hashes recorded.
CLOSE      Use the report sealed for that ID.
scenes.body: Close the task with its sealed report. Checklist rows track check results or owner decisions; manual closure needs a seal.
scenes.trace: Idea -> SC-002 -> check -> result -> sealed report -> recorded completion.
scenes.footer: The proof travels with the work. Shipping still waits for the owner.
